items.title: Tencent Hunyuan Releases Hy3D 3.6 for Professional High-Poly 3D Assets
items.excerpt: Tencent Hunyuan shipped Hy3D 3.6, a VAE + DiT 3D generation model aimed at production high-poly geometry and PBR texture maps for retopology, baking, 3D printing and film pipelines. It is API/product access (Tencent Cloud, Miora agent, LAP, WorkRally), not an open-weights drop. Note: og:image is an AI conceptual illustration, not a Hy3D output.
items.rationale: New 3D-generation model release that aims at production high-poly meshes with PBR maps; the orchestrator assigned this story to design only.

items.title: Cascadeur 2026.3 Adds MetaHuman Faces and Tentacle Rigging
items.excerpt: Nekki's AI- and physics-assisted animation tool Cascadeur 2026.3 adds MetaHuman face support and tentacle rigging, cleans up mocap jitter automatically, and lets outside AI assistants such as Claude Code edit scenes. Date and summary from AWN RSS (page is bot-walled).
items.rationale: New point release that adds automatic mocap cleanup and lets outside AI agents edit scenes, so animators can work with it right away.

items.title: THEIA update automates 3D models
items.excerpt: Spare Parts 3D updated THEIA AI to automate reconstruction of 3D models from 2D engineering drawings in formats compatible with engineering CAD software.
items.rationale: On-whitelist CAD outlet reporting a new THEIA release that turns 2D drawings into CAD-ready 3D models; a concrete update since the August card.

items.title: How I use AI as a solo designer
items.excerpt: A designer who moved from a 30+ person design team to being the only designer at a B2B e-commerce scale-up describes which AI workflows worked (and which failed), going beyond Figma Make, Gemini and Maze-assisted interviews.
items.rationale: A practitioner's account of which AI workflows held up and which failed when one designer covers a whole company; readers can apply it directly.

items.title: Your coding agent keeps writing the same UI. Give it real components instead
items.excerpt: Argues coding agents produce generic sections (the same pricing block everyone gets) unless fed a real component library, and shows how to wire components in as agent context.
items.rationale: Hands-on fix for generic agent-generated UI: give the agent the real component library as context. It covers new ground, unlike the DESIGN.md, AGENTS.md and radius-token pieces.

https://www.awn.com/news/cascadeur-20263.new_action: New version 2026.3 (design carded 2026.2 on 08-07, outside the 30-day digest): adds automatic mocap jitter cleanup, MetaHuman faces, tentacle rigging, and editing by outside AI assistants (Claude Code).

https://develop3d.com/ai/theia-update-au.new_action: New THEIA AI update release (Spare Parts 3D) that automates 2D-drawing to CAD-compatible 3D reconstruction; THEIA was last carded 08-27 via engineering.com, outside the 30-day digest. The IronCAD history_match is a different product.
